articles.summary: GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc. (“GrabAGun,” “we,” “us,” “our,” or the “Company”) (NYSE: PEW), a technology-driven commerce, distribution, and logistics company serving the firearms, ammunition, and outdoor industry, today announced that Chief Executive Officer, Marc Nemati and Chief Financial Officer, Jonathan Terry will present at the 18 th Annual Southwest IDEAS Investor Conference on Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at The Westin Convention Center at Las Colinas in Dallas, TX. The Company’s presentation is scheduled to begin at 3:20 pm CT. The presentation will be webcast and can be accessed through the conference host’s main website: https://www.threepartadvisors.com/southwest and in the investor relations section of the company's website: https://investors.grabagun.com/events-and-presentations. articles.summary: Veteran public-company executive brings extensive experience in financial leadership, capital markets and strategic growth GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc. (“GrabAGun” or the “Company”) (NYSE: PEW), a technology-driven commerce and platform company serving the firearms, ammunition and outdoor industry, today announced the appointment of W. Bryan Hill to its Board of Directors, effective November 9, 2026. Mr. Hill’s appointment further strengthens the Board’s public-company, financial and strategic expertise. Mr. Hill will serve on the Audit and MA Committees. The Board has determined that he is independent under New York Stock Exchange listing standards. “Bryan’s public-company leadership, financial discipline and strategic experience further strengthen our Board,” said Marc Nemati, President and Chief Executive Officer of GrabAGun. “His background in scaling technology businesses, capital allocation and financial oversight will be valuable as we advance our commerce and platform
articles.title: GrabAGun Appoints W. Bryan Hill to Board of Directors
